description: Attachment socket contract. Sockets are authored in Blender, preserved through FBX export, and bound in UE5.5.4. Every socket name is stable across all twelve pieces so armor, weapons, and capes are interchangeable within a faction.
rules: Socket names are stable across all twelve pieces — an armor set authored for one piece fits any piece of the same faction and body class.
Centaur knights use the _Equine suffixed hind sockets; biped pieces ignore them.
The castle staff socket exists on all pieces but only rooks ship with the staff attached.
No socket may be renamed after Phase 1 — downstream armor and weapon assets bind by name.

sockets.name: Socket_Weapon_R
sockets.purpose: Primary weapon mount (scepter-blade, war-fans, crosier, lance, short blade)

sockets.name: Socket_CastleStaff
sockets.purpose: Massive castle staff — the rook's signature weapon

sockets.name: Socket_Helm
sockets.purpose: Helm / crown / mitre mount; MetaHuman head stays underneath
